summary: Ground bounded workflow dispositions in each project-answer citation scope.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Numeric grounding did not reject non-numeric workflow-state reversals
Exact-citation fixtures proved that RFI closed/open, Submittal rejected/approved and Email pending/approved reversals were accepted before this change
approval_evidence: The user's persistent objective explicitly authorizes continued accuracy and multi-content adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: The check covers only an explicit bounded English workflow-disposition vocabulary and conservative equivalents; it is not general natural-language contradiction detection.
Per-source findings are citation-local, but a top-level comparison summary is checked against the union of its cited findings and does not prove clause-to-source alignment.
The check does not determine chronology, authority, winning precedence or contractual correctness.
Synthetic offline validation does not establish construction accuracy or live-provider behavior.
